bam.intro: Because the BAM pathway spans both undergraduate and graduate degrees, students are strongly encouraged to work closely with their undergraduate, graduate, and general education advisors to plan their coursework and progress through the program.

intro: Students are strongly encouraged to work closely with advisors to plan a meaningful path through their program and toward graduation. Advising can help with course selection, program requirements, academic planning, career paths, graduate school, declarations, minor verification, and graduation paperwork.
